Package paint.fiji.trackmate

Class TrackMateResults

java.lang.Object
paint.fiji.trackmate.TrackMateResults
public class TrackMateResults extends Object
Immutable container for the results of a TrackMate analysis.

Encapsulates statistics such as the number of detected spots, total and filtered tracks, number of analyzed frames, and runtime duration.

    • TrackMateResults

      public TrackMateResults(boolean success)
      Constructs a TrackMateResults instance with only a success flag. Assumes no calculations were performed and sets all numeric fields to zero.
      Parameters:
      success - whether the analysis succeeded

    • TrackMateResults

      public TrackMateResults(boolean success, boolean calculationPerformed, int numberOfSpots, int numberOfTracks, int numberOfFilteredTracks, int numberOfFrames, Duration duration, int numberOfSpotsInAllTracks)
      Constructs a fully detailed TrackMateResults instance.
      Parameters:
      success - true if the analysis succeeded
      calculationPerformed - true if processing was executed
      numberOfSpots - number of detected spots
      numberOfTracks - total number of identified tracks
      numberOfFilteredTracks - number of tracks after filtering
      numberOfFrames - total number of frames analyzed
      duration - runtime duration of analysis
      numberOfSpotsInAllTracks - total number of spots in all tracks
